featured_reviews.name: Vinay Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had pre booked the facility 4 months in advance for my brother’s wedding, for 500 pax. On the day of the wedding food was delayed by 45mins to an hour. At 11.30 we were informed that there is some issue with the gas burners. Imagine our shock and surprise. Wedding got over at 10.30-45am. Still we somehow managed the crowd till 12 noon, but food was not ready and we got to know they had just started preparing food sometime back.

Can you imagine the level of mismanagement and carelessness. For such an important function in our live we were half the time following up and arguing with them. And after 12 the female staff from the office came into the kitchen and started directing the staff.
Food was getting ready one by one at 12.30 when the feast should have started latest by 12. Guests had already gathered at the 2nd floor banquet by 11.45.

Finally one counter was opened at around 12.50pm that too without few items we had decided up on. There was commotion and long queues due to single counter. Next counter was opened at around 1.20pm.

I generally don’t write reviews, especially bad ones unless it’s absolutely necessary so that nobody else faces the same plight that we went through. Me and the parents were almost in tears because of the situation because crowd had gathered for food and we we were just saying 5 mins -10 mins everytime. It was the most embarrassing situation caused by casual and irresponsible people at Shri Balaji Banquet.

The real problem:

Multiple events taking place without proper planning: There was a baby naming ceremony on the 3rd floor, meaning food had to be prepared for both events. Who will plan for this???

Food order given to 3rd party: We were given Mr. Pankaj’s nimber for cordination but when things went south he said he’s a vendor and that the banquet management is responsible for this. He shared the owner’s number.

Spoke to Mr. Amit Sharma. No satisfactory response, No sorry, nothing. I still have the chats record. Zero response to my 100 messages. He just answered one call after multiple attempts to tell me that he will check. That’s it!

Our mistake: We made 100% payment upfront and that was a forced rule by the banquet management.

We trusted the wrong people.

Also there is only 1 small lift for the entire facility which is a huge hindrance especially for elderly and children and if there is another event that day then it’s gonna be a nightmare.

Final advice: If you want to waste your money and spoil your reputation and peace of mind then only book with them.

Hope this review helps atleast 1 person to escape our plight.

Thank you🙏🏼

Overall Worth a Family Visit - for all who like Veg food in the predominantly Veg loving area.

featured_reviews.name: Shikha Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent dining experience at Veg Sagar in Bhayandar West was an absolute treat for the taste buds. The restaurant's ambiance was cozy and inviting, setting the stage for a delightful meal.

We started our culinary journey with a classic favorite, pizza, and Veg Sagar did not disappoint. The pizza was freshly baked, with a perfectly crispy crust and a generous topping of flavorful veggies. It was a great appetizer to kick off our meal.

Next up was the paneer tikka masala, a staple in Indian cuisine. The paneer was tender and marinated to perfection, while the masala was rich, creamy, and packed with aromatic spices. It paired wonderfully with the fluffy naan served alongside.

We then ventured into the realm of Indo-Chinese cuisine with the dry manchurian. The dish was a delightful blend of crispy vegetables tossed in a tangy and slightly spicy sauce. Each bite was bursting with flavor, leaving us craving for more.

To wash down our delectable meal, we opted for the refreshing fruit punch. It was a delightful combination of various fruits, perfectly blended to create a refreshing and thirst-quenching beverage.

Throughout our dining experience, the service at Veg Sagar was impeccable. The staff was courteous, attentive, and went out of their way to ensure that we had a memorable dining experience.

In conclusion, Veg Sagar in Bhayandar West offers a diverse and delicious selection of vegetarian dishes that are sure to satisfy even the most discerning palate. Whether you're craving classic Indian flavors or adventurous fusion cuisine, Veg Sagar has something for everyone. I highly recommend giving this restaurant a try for a truly delightful dining experience.

Had requested previous day for 11 am checking post paying part advance but rooms were allocated at 12.30 pm
Had intimated that we require 2 rooms for 2 Adults in 1 Room and 3 Children in another room [1 Adult child & 2 Minor children] , which was agreed over the call booking

Post lot of squabble to ever changing personnel from Fab Hotel team, they raised their hands and said whatever local team says please adhere.
They demanded Rs 1500/ for additional Child with extra mattress - Where as it was written Rs 500/- for additional person and Rs 150/- for mattress.
Anyways we paid / settled for Rs 1000/- and sorted it out post lot of chaos and bit of headache which could have been avoided seriously.
Pic attached with their Rules & more.

No Proper Reception personal
No proper Rules
NO PARKING SPACE
Security was handling Entry and payment post 12 .15 pm
Aadhar Card mandatory and post haggling Driver license was accepted, though any photo identity with address proof is accepted.

Property close to main road so 24/7 traffic sound and lot of flying dust as construction / metro work on....

Think twice before booking this place for the price of almost Rs 2000/ per room without Breakfast for 2 pax and Rs 1000/- for every additional pax plus Service charges of almost 10% and GST.

featured_reviews.review_text:
​I recently attended an event at Dev Vatika Hall in Bhayandar West and was thoroughly impressed by the management and facilities.
​As a strict vegetarian, it is a huge relief to visit a venue that maintains a purely vegetarian environment and menu. The catering was excellent, and the food quality was exceptional from start to finish.
​A few specific highlights from my visit:
​Photography & Lighting: The venue's built-in decor is lavish and well-thought-out. The ambient lighting was excellent—I was able to get some beautifully crisp, vibrant shots on my Nikon Z5 without constantly battling harsh indoor shadows or needing heavy EXIF edits later.
​Space & Comfort: The hall easily accommodates a large crowd. With multiple floors and strong air conditioning, it never felt cramped or uncomfortable, even during the peak of the event.
​Location & Accessibility: Situated centrally in Shanti Nagar, it is a very straightforward commute, particularly if you are just crossing the bridge over from Bhayandar East.
​Overall, it is a highly organized, premium venue in the Mira-Bhayandar area. I highly recommend it for weddings, receptions, or any large family gatherings
